verdict.rationale: Increase documents Entity validations exposed through the API for each version of a customer's data. It tells the platform to follow up with its customer when a validation flags a data issue, which gives some visibility into why an entity is held up and implies the platform owns customer follow-up. The evidence mentions no onboarding queue, document upload or supplementation, or explicit split between platform and bank decisions. missing for 10: an onboarding queue or status view with pending reasons, a supporting-document submission capability, documentation of which decisions belong to the platform versus the bank, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
